data.name: Muqtadir
data.gender_notes: Muqtadir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is determined and unyielding in his actions, a person who is in control of his destiny. The name Muqtadir carries the meaning “Determined, Firm, Decisive” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Muqtadir usually hope their child will grow to embody determined, firm, decisive and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Muqtadir is a name that represents the inner strength and determination of an individual, his ability to withstand the tests of fate and emerge victorious
data.etymology: Muqtadir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Determined, Firm, Decisive.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muqtadir total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_english.name: Muqtadir
in_english.meaning: Muqtadir is a name that means ruler, decision-maker, or destined
in_english.long_meaning: Muqtadir is a name that means ruler, decision-maker, or destined. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'q-d-r' meaning to dominate, control, or decree. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with the concept of divine power and authority. It is also linked to the idea of destiny and fate. This name is considered suitable for individuals who possess leadership qualities, are skilled decision-makers, or are destined for greatness. In Islamic culture, this name is significant because it reflects the idea of Allah's omnipotence and control over all things. It is also considered a name that conveys wisdom, intelligence, and strategic thinking.
